metadata.description: AI-driven Google Ads operator for non-technical SaaS founders

plugins.name: google-ads-copilot
plugins.description: Nine slash commands (daily, weekly, monthly, search-terms, budgets, creative, bootstrap, explain, apply) backed by an ads-manager agent and 7 skills. The 'apply' command is the only one that mutates the account; everything else is read-only or writes a proposal file.
